review_notes: I read the whole file and the Mathlib directory Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology. That directory has resolutionMap, cochainsMap, map, map_id and map_comp for a general group homomorphism. It has no functor on TopRep for fixed n and G. It also has no additivity lemmas (resolutionMap_add, cochainsMap_add, map_add) and no map_zero. A Grep for continuousCohomology together with Functor, and for map_add and map_zero, in that directory found nothing relevant. coefficientFunctor is a named specialisation of Mathlib's `map` at the identity homomorphism, and its object and morphism parts are Mathlib's own. It does not introduce a competing concept. The additivity lemmas are new API. I did not search Mathlib's non-continuous group cohomology for a similar functor, because that is a different concept. I found no justified finding.
